summary: Iter76: validated the 4 new admin users CRUD endpoints (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/users) + frontend /admin/users list and /admin/users/new + /admin/users/:id edit form. 12 new pytest cases pass + full 70-test regression on iter70-75 still pass (82/82 total). End-to-end UI flow (login -> list (166 rows) -> add -> create -> edit -> update -> back to list -> delete) all OK with all expected data-testids present.

issues: Default login screen is phone-only (OTP). Email/password login requires clicking 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion'. Tests had to authenticate via direct POST /api/auth/login. Not a bug — but worth noting that automation/E2E tests cannot trivially login via the email/password form unless they click into the alternative options sub-page.

critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/admin/users/{id} returns only {'updated': True}. Consider returning the updated user object so the frontend can avoid a refetch.

Backend create_user accepts phone without normalization beyond stripping spaces. If a user types '+33 6 12...' (with + already) plus phone_code '+33', the combined value will start with '+33+33...' is avoided by the `not phone.startswith('+')` guard — good. However, no E.164 / regex validation, so admins can store any free-text phone. Low risk.
Frontend AdminUserEdit `reset()` calls setForm(empty) + setAvatarPreview before load() resolves — if isNew=false, the empty state is briefly visible during the GET refetch. Minor UX flicker.

AdminUsers.js: deleting a user with role=admin via the row trash button shows backend's 400 'Impossible de supprimer un admin via cette route' toast — good, the message surfaces correctly through `err?.response?.data?.detail`.

user_name-{id} button opens /admin/users/{id}; also row's edit pencil and view-docs both navigate to the same edit page — consider if 'view-docs' (Eye icon) should open a documents sub-route instead. Currently it duplicates the edit action.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (list render, filters present, sort buttons present, add/create, edit/update, back to list, delete via API cleanup)

seed_data_creation: Each pytest creates TEST_iter76_* users and cleans them up in finally blocks. UI test created one user_f392692567e2 and deleted it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter76 admin users CRUD (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/users) is fully validated backend + frontend. Listing has 166 rows; sort/filter/bulk/export/add UI all wired. The avatar dropzone reads file as data URL and is sent inline in POST/PUT payload — this was not stress-tested with a real upload but the form fields and handlers are wired correctly. Run regression: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter70_kiosk.py tests/test_iter71_p0_refactor.py tests/test_iter72_phase2_ui.py tests/test_iter73_fixes.py tests/test_iter74_acl_admins.py tests/test_iter75_refactor_smoke.py tests/test_iter76_admin_users.py` — 82 passed.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no regressions found, all new endpoints + form work end-to-end.
